content.title: Why 89bio Stock Lagged the Market Today
content.summary: 89bio (NASDAQ: ETNB) couldn't quite keep pace with the broader stock market on Tuesday.  Investors were hesitant to buy shares of the clinical-stage biotech, following news that it was floating a new stock issue.  Just after market close on Monday, 89bio divulged that it intends to raise as much as $287.5 million from a secondary stock issue.
